post.title: Your Discord messages, on Google?
post.caption:
Your Discord messages could soon show up on Google. 🔎

Discord is giving Discoverable Servers (the big public ones listed in Server Discovery) public web pages: AI summaries of selected channels from 16 Nov, and messages that search engines can find from mid-December. DMs and private servers aren't included. To keep your messages off: User Settings › Data & Privacy › turn off "Show my message content from Discoverable channels on web pages". Messages already shown can stay, and search engines may keep cached copies, so switch it off before December. Server admins: Server Settings › Web Presence.
Send this to a friend who lives on Discord.
